list.name: Postgres start
list.expr: {container_name="wojtus-postgres"} |= "database system is ready to accept connections"

target.expr: {container_name="wojtus-postgres"} |= "database system is ready to accept connections"

description: Postgres 18 for the WojtusDiscord bot: postgres_exporter (job wojtus-postgres), checkpoints parsed from the Postgres log, container memory from the host.

options.content: **Is Postgres healthy and what loads it?** State, throughput, tables, the statements that cost the most (pg_stat_statements), and the container. Locks, checkpoints and WAL are in the collapsed row.

panels.title: Postgres
panels.description: pg_up from postgres_exporter: 1 when the exporter can query Postgres.

panels.title: Database size
panels.description: Size of discord_event_service on disk, with its trend over the dashboard range.

panels.title: Connections
panels.description: Backends connected to discord_event_service as a share of max_connections.

panels.title: Uptime
panels.description: Time since the postmaster started. A low value means Postgres restarted.

panels.title: Longest transaction
panels.description: Age of the oldest open transaction in discord_event_service. Long transactions block vacuum.

panels.title: XID wraparound
panels.description: Oldest datfrozenxid age as a share of the 2^31 XID limit. The exporter metric name says seconds, the value is an XID count. Autovacuum forces a freeze at 200M XIDs (9.3%).

panels.title: Rows read per second
panels.description: returned = rows scanned, fetched = rows a query used. A wide gap means scans read rows they discard.

panels.title: Buffer cache hit ratio
panels.description: Share of block reads served from shared_buffers. No point when no block is read.

panels.title: Temp file bytes written
panels.description: Bytes that sorts and hashes spilled to disk because they did not fit in work_mem (4 MiB).

panels.title: Temp files
panels.description: Temp files created in the dashboard range.

panels.title: Deadlocks
panels.description: Deadlocks detected in the dashboard range.

panels.title: Tables
panels.description: One row per table. Seq scan share is lifetime (stats were never reset). An empty age cell means autovacuum or autoanalyze never ran on the table. The hangfire schema holds the job queue: small tables with high churn.

panels.title: Insert rate, event tables
panels.description: Fixed list of the eight append-heavy event tables. The Tables panel has the rate for every table.

panels.title: Sequential vs index scans
panels.description: Scans started per second on the public schema.

panels.title: Dead-tuple ratio, top 10
panels.description: Dead rows as a share of all rows. Public schema, tables with at least 100 rows.

defaults.noValue: No table with 100 rows or more

panels.title: Rows read by sequential scans, top 10
panels.description: Rows per second that sequential scans read, mean over the range. Public schema.

defaults.noValue: No sequential scan in this time range

panels.title: Queries (pg_stat_statements)
panels.description: Query text comes from the exporter and stops at 120 characters. Full text: SELECT query FROM pg_stat_statements WHERE queryid = <id>.

panels.title: Top 10 by execution time

targets.expr: (topk(10, sum by (queryid)(rate(pg_stat_statements_seconds_total{job="wojtus-postgres",datname="discord_event_service"}[$__range])) > 0)) * on (queryid) group_left (query) max by (queryid, query)(pg_stat_statements_query_id{job="wojtus-postgres"})

panels.description: Average over the dashboard range. Seconds of execution per second of wall clock: the share of one CPU-second the query takes. Query text comes from the exporter and stops at 120 characters. Full text: SELECT query FROM pg_stat_statements WHERE queryid = <id>.

defaults.noValue: No statement ran in this time range

panels.title: Top 10 by calls

targets.expr: (topk(10, sum by (queryid)(rate(pg_stat_statements_calls_total{job="wojtus-postgres",datname="discord_event_service"}[$__range])) > 0)) * on (queryid) group_left (query) max by (queryid, query)(pg_stat_statements_query_id{job="wojtus-postgres"})

panels.description: Average over the dashboard range. Calls per second. Query text comes from the exporter and stops at 120 characters. Full text: SELECT query FROM pg_stat_statements WHERE queryid = <id>.

defaults.noValue: No statement ran in this time range

panels.title: Top 10 by mean time per call

targets.expr: (topk(10, sum by (queryid)(rate(pg_stat_statements_seconds_total{job="wojtus-postgres",datname="discord_event_service"}[$__range])) / (sum by (queryid)(rate(pg_stat_statements_calls_total{job="wojtus-postgres",datname="discord_event_service"}[$__range])) > 0))) * on (queryid) group_left (query) max by (queryid, query)(pg_stat_statements_query_id{job="wojtus-postgres"})

panels.description: Average over the dashboard range. Execution time rate divided by calls rate. A slow query with few calls shows here first. Query text comes from the exporter and stops at 120 characters. Full text: SELECT query FROM pg_stat_statements WHERE queryid = <id>.

defaults.noValue: No statement ran in this time range

panels.title: Top 10 by rows per call

targets.expr: (topk(10, sum by (queryid)(rate(pg_stat_statements_rows_total{job="wojtus-postgres",datname="discord_event_service"}[$__range])) / (sum by (queryid)(rate(pg_stat_statements_calls_total{job="wojtus-postgres",datname="discord_event_service"}[$__range])) > 0))) * on (queryid) group_left (query) max by (queryid, query)(pg_stat_statements_query_id{job="wojtus-postgres"})

panels.description: Average over the dashboard range. Rows returned or changed per call. Query text comes from the exporter and stops at 120 characters. Full text: SELECT query FROM pg_stat_statements WHERE queryid = <id>.

defaults.noValue: No statement ran in this time range

panels.title: Queries

targets.expr: (sum by (queryid)(rate(pg_stat_statements_seconds_total{job="wojtus-postgres",datname="discord_event_service"}[$__range])) / (sum by (queryid)(rate(pg_stat_statements_calls_total{job="wojtus-postgres",datname="discord_event_service"}[$__range])) > 0)) * on (queryid) group_left (query) max by (queryid, query)(pg_stat_statements_query_id{job="wojtus-postgres"})

(sum by (queryid)(rate(pg_stat_statements_rows_total{job="wojtus-postgres",datname="discord_event_service"}[$__range])) / (sum by (queryid)(rate(pg_stat_statements_calls_total{job="wojtus-postgres",datname="discord_event_service"}[$__range])) > 0)) * on (queryid) group_left (query) max by (queryid, query)(pg_stat_statements_query_id{job="wojtus-postgres"})

panels.description: One row per queryid. Rates are averages over the dashboard range; the last two columns count since the last pg_stat_statements reset or Postgres restart. Query text comes from the exporter and stops at 120 characters. Full text: SELECT query FROM pg_stat_statements WHERE queryid = <id>.

panels.title: Locks by mode
panels.description: Locks held now in discord_event_service, by lock mode.

panels.title: Background writer buffers
panels.description: Buffers allocated and buffers the background writer cleaned, per second.

panels.title: WAL size
panels.description: WAL directory size against max_wal_size. WAL above the setting forces checkpoints.

panels.title: Checkpoint duration
panels.description: Parsed from the Postgres log line 'checkpoint complete'. The exporter has no pg_stat_checkpointer metrics.

panels.title: Buffers written by checkpoints
panels.description: Parsed from the Postgres log line 'checkpoint complete'. One buffer is 8 kB.

panels.title: Checkpoints by trigger
panels.description: 'time' = checkpoint_timeout, the normal case. 'wal' = max_wal_size reached, a sign of write pressure.

panels.title: Container memory
panels.description: cgroup memory of the wojtus-postgres container from the host textfile collector. The container has no memory limit.

panels.title: OOM kills
panels.description: OOM kills in the container cgroup since the container started.
